name: The Golden Winged Great Peng
source:
The responsible for the massacre of the city in The Lion Camel Kingdom. He is one of the three Yaoguai of Shituo Ridge. Of an unpredictable personality, his actions are hard to comprehend, yet he often accomplishes remarkable feats. The eldest Yaoguai brother is the violent [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ajige]Green Lion[/url], the second is the cunning and scheming [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dorgon]White Elephant[/url], and [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shunzhi_Emperor]Tathagata Buddha[/url] who is yet to become Buddha, is his own nephew.
Based on [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dodo,_Prince_Yu]Dodo, Prince Yu[/url].
